capabilities: Add a Create nested note command to the file explorer context menu
Create a folder and a same-named Markdown note in one step
Open the newly created note automatically
Accept names with or without the .md extension
Prevent invalid filenames and path collisions
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or newer; works on desktop and mobile; operates offline with no accounts, telemetry, or network requests; tested with BrowserStack.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer cannot create a folder and a matching note together in one step, so users must make each separately.
summary: File-explorer utility that creates a folder plus a same-named Markdown note from the right-click context menu.
